newsitem.title: UK: Allied up as Morgan Stanley repeats "buy".
newsitem.headline: Allied up as Morgan Stanley repeats "buy".

text.p: Shares in Allied Domecq Plc rose on Thursday as analysts at Morgan Stanley repeated a "buy" recommendation on the stock following a presentation from company executives yesterday, market sources said.

The stock was up 4-1/2p at 424-1/2 by 1050 GMT, after earlier rising as high as 430p. Allied shares have underperformed the market in recent months and touched a low of 407p on January 17, their lowest in over five years.
Sources said Morgan Stanley analysts still had reservations about Allied's strategy but the stock was undervalued after its recent poor performance.
